title: Closest Approach
statement: Real numbers $x$ and $y$ satisfy $3x + 4y = 10$. Find the minimum value of $x^2 + y^2$.
hints: Geometrically: how close does the line $3x+4y=10$ come to the origin?
solution: By Cauchy–Schwarz, $(3x+4y)^2 \le (3^2+4^2)(x^2+y^2)$, so $x^2+y^2 \ge 100/25 = 4$, with equality at $(x,y) = (\tfrac65, \tfrac85)$. The minimum is $4$.
